config.selection_rule: Rank bottom-quartile neighbor-count centers by count, then observed sequence index; require sufficient heterogeneous membership; skip duplicate memberships; greedily retain patches only when Jaccard overlap with every retained patch is at most max_jaccard.
config.surface_proxy: Other CA atoms within neighbor_radius; lower is surface-like, not SASA.
config.heterogeneity_rule: At least two identity types is required only for a nonidentity permutation to exist; scores never inform selection.

descriptor.definition: Number of patch contacts with both endpoints hydrophobic divided by all eligible patch contacts; zero contacts yields null.
descriptor.delta_sign: permuted minus original; no biological preferred direction

config.geometry_control: Both pair members share exactly one stored backbone geometry, membership set and contact graph.

interpretation: Composition-matched arrangement controls, not aggregation labels. Multiple pairs per source protein are not independent biological replicates.
